fields.name: PDU session type value
fields.description: PDU session type value (octet 1, bit 1 to bit 3): 001=IPv4, 010=IPv6, 011=IPv4v6, 100=Unstructured, 101=Ethernet, 111=reserved. All other values are unused and shall be interpreted as 'IPv4v6', if received by the UE or the network.

notes: PDU session type value (octet 1, bit 1 to bit 3):
All other values are unused and shall be interpreted as 'IPv4v6', if received by the UE or the network.
